subject: Re: Elara Health — multi-year retainer + sideletter for ramped pricing
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Bloom <sara@elarahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Elara Health — multi-year retainer + sideletter for ramped pricing

Sara / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great discussion. Attached is a compact proposal for a three-year retainer that aligns price breaks to the usage ramp you outlined. High level:

- Term: 36 months with annual true-up and an optional mid-contract adjustment at month 18.
- Year 1: conservative floor + heavy ramp-based discount (to help you get started).
- Year 2–3: step-down discounts that reward sustained consumption.
- Governance: quarterly business reviews and an SLA addendum in the sideletter.

I uploaded a one-page summary (Elara_3yr_term_proposal.pdf) with the suggested breakpoints. We can carve a sideletter to lock in the step-down schedule and the true-up mechanics. If Procurement needs a PO/SOW cadence, I can hand off to Marcus to finalize the billing cadence.

Requested next steps:
1) Tell us if a 36-month window with a mid-contract true-up works for legal/procurement.
2) Confirm any minimum monthly invoice floor you need in year 1.
3) If acceptable, we’ll prepare a sideletter + DocuSign and route for signature.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: Elara_3yr_term_proposal.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Sara Bloom <sara@elarahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 14:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Elara Health — multi-year retainer + sideletter for ramped pricing

Thanks, Hannah — this looks promising. A few quick items from procurement before legal:

- We need a guaranteed monthly minimum for year 1 (finance requires visibility). Can you confirm your recommended floor and whether it counts against the annual true-up?
- Please provide a simple table of the monthly/quarterly breakpoints (we prefer quarterly billing).
- DocuSign is preferred for the sideletter. Is there an expected timeline to get the signed sideletter in place?

Also copying our procurement lead to track: procurement@elarahealth.com

Best,
Sara Bloom
Director, Data Product | Elara Health

Subject: RE: Elara Health — multi-year retainer + sideletter for ramped pricing

Hannah / Monica — looping in a quick ops note and the discount matrix (attached).

Proposed operational answers:
- Year 1 monthly floor: $15,000 / month (counts toward annual true-up). We can size the floor lower ($10k) if Elara agrees to a tighter ramp milestone.
- Quarterly breakpoint table: see discount_matrix.xlsx — I mapped quarters to token bands and effective per-token price.
- DocuSign timeline: I can generate the sideletter template today. If Sara confirms the floor, we can route DocuSign within 48 hours.

Approval ask (internal):
- Approve exception: 20% effective discount in Year 1 conditional on hitting Q3 and Q4 breakpoints (measured by usage). If we don’t hit Q3, revert to 12% (no retrospective clawback).

Monica — does CS support the QBR cadence and the conditional ramp metrics? If yes I’ll mark this as approved for DocuSign prep.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: discount_matrix.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0000
Subject: RE: Elara Health — multi-year retainer + sideletter for ramped pricing

Thanks Marcus — CS is supportive of the QBR cadence and the conditional ramp metrics. A couple of operational notes:

- We’ll need a kickoff success plan in the sideletter that lists the dashboard metrics and two cohort-specific prompts for performance monitoring (so we can validate Q3/Q4 breakpoints).
- If Elara chooses the lower $10k floor, CS will require a 60-day enablement window with dedicated onboarding support (we can include that as a credited service in year 1).

Approve moving to DocuSign with the conditional 20% Year 1 discount, dependent on the Q3/Q4 breakpoint language and the success-plan clause.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Sara — thanks for the quick turn. Per Procurement’s ask, here’s the final position we can commit to:

- Term: 36 months.
- Year 1 floor: $12,500 / month (counts toward annual true-up).
- Year 1 discount: 20% effective rate if Q3 and Q4 breakpoints are met; otherwise 12% for Year 1 (no retrospective clawbacks).
- Year 2–3 step-down: incremental price normalization per discount_matrix.xlsx.
- Operational items: 60-day enablement (credited if you pick $10k floor) and quarterly business reviews as part of the sideletter.

I’ve prepared the sideletter and routed it for signature — DocuSign link below. Please have procurement sign the sideletter and we’ll attach it to the master services agreement.
